title: Dinner Lady Tobacco Menthol 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Bar Salts Menthol Tobacco delivers a smooth and refreshing take on a classic tobacco blend. Combining the mellow character of Virginia Tobacco with a cooling burst of crisp Menthol, this flavour offers a balanced mix of warmth and freshness. A delicate touch of Caramel and Vanilla adds subtle sweetness, enhancing the depth of the tobacco without overpowering its authentic taste. Part of the Bar Salts collection, Menthol Tobacco is designed to replicate the satisfying, layered flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a full-bodied, long-lasting taste while maintaining a smooth and enjoyable vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid provides an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their dedication to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a trusted choice for vapers.
